Every time you start Thunderbird, the message area will load your Mail Start Page. You can change the mail start page to any webpage, or set it to a blank page.
{for win}
[[Image:tb60-startpage|width=436]]
{/for}

__TOC__

= Change the start page =
# [[T:optionspreferences TB]]
# Select the {menu General} panel on the left.
# In the ''Location'' field, enter the address of your desired start page.
[[Image:TB102-settings-general-thunderbird-start-page]]

= Set it to a blank page =
# [[T:optionspreferences TB]]
# Select the {menu General} panel on the left.
# Uncheck '''When Thunderbird launches, show the Start Page in the message area'''.

= Restore the default start page =
The default start page will welcome you to Thunderbird, provide information about Thunderbird, and provide links for how to get involved, where to donate, and where to get help.

# [[T:optionspreferences TB]]
# Select the {menu General} panel on the left.
# Make sure '''When Thunderbird launches, show the start page in the message area''' is checked.
# Click the {button Restore Default} button.

= Go to the start page any time =
{for win,linux}Click the menu button [[Image:Fx57Menu]], open the {menu Go} menu and choose {menu Mail Start Page}.{/for}{for mac}From the {menu Go} menu, choose {menu Mail Start Page}.{/for}
